role: The one-slot crafting result inventory; decrStackSize hands back the whole stack and empties the slot, and the result is recomputed from the grid after every change.

members.name: getSizeInventory
members.note: n/a: nothing reads the craft result this way: the containers close over their grids, Slot.getSlotStackLimit is reached only past isItemValid (SlotCrafting refuses every stack), and no comparator or hopper faces a result

members.name: decrStackSize
members.note: the INV_RESULT branch: the whole stack, count ignored
